headline: Nvidia GPU shortage intensifies as flagship cards disappear, prices spike
body: Nvidia has pulled the RTX 5080 from its store following the RTX 5090 removal, while street prices for remaining high-end GPUs climb to 2.2X MSRP. This supply crunch directly impacts healthcare AI infrastructure planning, particularly for organizations building large language model pipelines for clinical documentation, radiology analysis, and genomic processing. Healthcare systems and consulting firms evaluating GPU procurement for on-premise AI workloads now face cost overruns and extended timelines that compress already tight budgets. The parallel emergence of alternatives like FuriosaAI's $2.9B valuation signals the market recognizing vendor risk, making it critical for healthcare IT leaders to diversify GPU sourcing strategies beyond Nvidia's consumer and pro lines. Expect longer hardware lead times and higher capex requirements in RFPs for healthcare AI infrastructure through 2025.
